cues.en: Trigonometry is the study of angles.
cues.zh: 三角學研究角度。

cues.en: Now there are entire books and courses dedicated solely to trigonometry.
cues.zh: 有整本書、整門課，只談三角學。

cues.en: So in this one video, I'm actually just going to introduce you to what you need to know about trigonometry for the rest of this course.
cues.zh: 所以這支只介紹本課後面需要知道的三角學。

cues.en: And actually, you'll learn a lot more about trig functions later in the course, for example, in the sections on derivatives.
cues.zh: 後面還會學更多三角函數，例如導數章節。

cues.en: But in this video I want to introduce you to sign and cosine and also tangent, and I will explain where those come from and what those functions mean.
cues.zh: 這支介紹正弦、餘弦和正切，解釋來源與含義。

cues.en: And I will also introduce you to some of the basic properties of sine and cosine.
cues.zh: 也會介紹正弦、餘弦的基本性質。

cues.en: First, let me just start with this word trigonometry.
cues.zh: 先從 trigonometry 這個字。

cues.en: What does this word even mean?
cues.zh: 到底是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, it comes from Trigon and mercury.
cues.zh: 來自 trigon 和 metry。

cues.en: So the measurement of a trigon.
cues.zh: 就是測量 trigon。

cues.en: And what is what is a tri gun?
cues.zh: trigon 是什麼？

cues.en: Well, the funny thing is that the Neuroscience Research Institute, where I work is actually called the tri gun building or Tricon in Dutch.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，我工作的神經科學研究機構，大樓就叫 Trigon，荷蘭文也是 Trigon。

cues.en: And you can see that it's actually shaped a bit like a triangle.
cues.zh: 可以看到，形狀有點像三角形。

cues.en: And in fact, the word tri gun is just an old school term for a triangle.
cues.zh: 其實 trigon 就是三角形的舊稱。

cues.en: So try four, three and gun for shape, you know, like hexagon or polygon dodecahedron.
cues.zh: tri 表三，gon 表形狀，像 hexagon、polygon、dodecahedron。

cues.en: But trigonometry isn't just about all triangles.
cues.zh: 但三角學不只是所有三角形。

cues.en: It's really about right triangles or triangles that have 190 degree angle.
cues.zh: 主要是直角三角形，也就是有一個 90 度角的三角形。

cues.en: So here is a right triangle.
cues.zh: 這就是直角三角形。

cues.en: And really the entirety of trigonometry is about characterizing this angle over here.
cues.zh: 三角學基本上就是描述這裡的角。

cues.en: So here are some labels.
cues.zh: 加上標示。

cues.en: I'm sure these look familiar to you from high school and you might also be familiar with, or at least recognize these equations here, these definitions.
cues.zh: 高中應該看過，也可能熟悉或至少認得這些方程式、定義。

cues.en: So the cosine of this angle theta is equal to the adjacent over the hypotenuse.
cues.zh: 角 θ 的餘弦，等於鄰邊除斜邊。

cues.en: So the distance, the length of the adjacent line divided by the length of the hypotenuse, and then
cues.zh: 就是鄰邊長除斜邊長；接著，

cues.en: also for sine and tangent and tangent can be re expressed as the ratio of sine to cosine.
cues.zh: 正弦與正切也是，而正切能改寫成正弦除餘弦。

cues.en: When I was in school, we remembered these rules.
cues.zh: 我上學時，這樣記法則。

cues.en: We memorize these rules using Sokoto, this little abbreviation, Sokoto.
cues.zh: 用 SOHCAHTOA 這個縮寫背起來。

cues.en: So sign or opposite or sign of theta equals opposite over hypotenuse.
cues.zh: S、O、H，也就是 sin(θ)=對邊/斜邊。

cues.en: The cosine of theta equals the adjacent over the hypotenuse and so on.
cues.zh: cos(θ)=鄰邊/斜邊，依此類推。

cues.en: For some reason cosine was always my favorite.
cues.zh: 不知為何，餘弦一直是我最喜歡的。

cues.en: I really like computing cosine.
cues.zh: 很喜歡計算餘弦。

cues.en: Anyway, the point is that sine and cosine are ratios and ratios are interesting because it doesn't
cues.zh: 總之，正弦、餘弦是比值，比值很有趣，因為，

cues.en: matter what the lengths of the triangles are actually measured in.
cues.zh: 三角形邊長用什麼單位都無關。

cues.en: They can be measured in feet or millimeters or light years.
cues.zh: 英尺、毫米、光年都可以。

cues.en: The units will cancel in this ratio.
cues.zh: 單位會在比值裡消掉。

cues.en: And so that ratio is actually unit less.
cues.zh: 所以比值其實沒有單位。

cues.en: But the angle here does have a unit of course, and the units here are radians and Radian is a measure
cues.zh: 不過角度當然有單位，這裡用弧度，衡量，

cues.en: of the angle around the circle and it goes from zero radians to two pi for one full cycle around the circle.
cues.zh: 繞圓的角，完整一圈從零到 2π 弧度。

cues.en: Now sometimes you might also see this written as minus pi to plus pi.
cues.zh: 有時也會看到寫成 −π 到正 π。

cues.en: That's usually done in scientific applications where people want to show a deviation from zero radians.
cues.zh: 科學應用常這樣，用來顯示偏離零弧度的程度。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: But anyway, so this is one triangle and that produces one angle here.
cues.zh: 這是一個三角形，產生一個角。

cues.en: But usually when you see sine and cosine, it's with these wavy curvy functions like this.
cues.zh: 但看到正弦、餘弦時，通常是這種波浪曲線。

cues.en: So how do we get from here to here?
cues.zh: 要怎麼從這裡到這裡？

cues.en: Well, that comes from putting the triangle in circle like you see here.
cues.zh: 就是像這樣，把三角形放進圓。

cues.en: And now we assume that this white circle here, this is a unit circle that means it has a radius of
cues.zh: 假設白色圓是單位圓，半徑，

cues.en: one or the distance between any point in the circle and the origin is exactly one.
cues.zh: 為一，也就是圓上任一點到原點的距離恰好一。

cues.en: So this point of the triangle is exactly touching this circle here.
cues.zh: 三角形這個頂點，恰好碰到圓。

cues.en: And that means that this the length of this line here, which is the hypotenuse of this triangle, this length is one that's just by definition we assume that this is a unit circle.
cues.zh: 所以這條線，也就是斜邊，長度為一，因為定義上假設是單位圓。

cues.en: And so this length is exactly equal to one.
cues.zh: 因此長度恰好一。

cues.en: And now what you can imagine is moving this point around on the unit circle like that.
cues.zh: 可以想像，讓這個點沿單位圓移動。

cues.en: So here, this is one point and now you can move this point over here.
cues.zh: 這是一個位置，再移到這裡。

cues.en: Now, when you move this point over here, this angle is going to change.
cues.zh: 移到這裡，這個角就改變。

cues.en: This angle doesn't change.
cues.zh: 這個角不變。

cues.en: This stays fixed at 90 degrees.
cues.zh: 固定 90 度。

cues.en: This is a right angle.
cues.zh: 是直角。

cues.en: So this line over here is always horizontal.
cues.zh: 所以這條線永遠水平。

cues.en: This line over here is always exactly vertical.
cues.zh: 這條永遠垂直。

cues.en: But as you move this point on the triangle around the unit circle, that's going to change this angle and it's going to change not the length of the hypotenuse that's always fixed.
cues.zh: 但頂點沿圓移動，就會改變角度，不會改變斜邊長度，永遠固定，

cues.en: At one, but it will change the orientation of that hypotenuse, this line relative to the positive x axis here.
cues.zh: 為一，但會改變斜邊相對正 x 軸的方向。

cues.en: So as this angle changes, the length of this line is also going to change and the length of this line
cues.zh: 角度變，這條線長也變，另一條也是，

cues.en: and now the length of this line, this is the cosine of this angle.
cues.zh: 而這條線長，就是角度的餘弦。

cues.en: And that's what you see plotted out here.
cues.zh: 這裡畫的就是它。

cues.en: So for different angles of theta, we have different lengths of this line and it's positive when it goes to the right and it's a negative length when it goes to the left.
cues.zh: 不同 θ 角，這條線長不同，向右是正，向左是負的長度。

cues.en: And that's why you see this x y axis here go from positive down to negative and it crosses through zero.
cues.zh: 所以這裡圖形從正降到負，經過零。

cues.en: So what I would like you to imagine is that at every time point, imagine we have a clock that's ticking
cues.zh: 請想像，每個時間點，有個時鐘，

cues.en: at one second and at every second this point here where the triangle meets the unit circle moves over by one tiny little step, one small step.
cues.zh: 每秒滴答一次，每秒三角形與單位圓交會的頂點，都移一小步。

cues.en: Every second it moves over.
cues.zh: 每秒移動。

cues.en: So the radian angle is changing, and that means that the projection down onto the x axis is also changing.
cues.zh: 弧度角改變，投影到 x 軸的結果也改變。

cues.en: As this moves closer like this, closer to the left, then the projection down onto the x axis will shrink.
cues.zh: 這樣越往左移，x 軸投影就縮短。

cues.en: It will get smaller and eventually this point is going to be over here.
cues.zh: 越來越小，最後點會到這裡。

cues.en: And then, well, we don't really have a triangle at this point.
cues.zh: 這時其實沒有三角形。

cues.en: We just have a straight line, just a vertical line here.
cues.zh: 只有直線、垂直線。

cues.en: And then the projection onto the x axis, which is cosine is zero.
cues.zh: 投影到 x 軸，也就是餘弦，等於零。

cues.en: And that's what happens here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是這情況。

cues.en: And then as the point goes here, the projection down onto the x axis is negative and it gets larger
cues.zh: 再移到這邊，投影到 x 軸是負，長度越來，

cues.en: and larger until this point is all the way over here, at which point we also don't really formally have a triangle anymore.
cues.zh: 越大，直到點到這裡，又不再正式構成三角形。

cues.en: We just have a flat line over here.
cues.zh: 只剩水平線。

cues.en: Okay, Now I have a animation of this that I'm going to show you in the next slide.
cues.zh: 好，下一張會有動畫。

cues.en: It's an animation that I got from Wikipedia, but I would like you to try to visualize this animation in your imagination before you see it first.
cues.zh: 從維基百科取得，但希望先在腦中想像，再看。

cues.en: And that's because you know it's helpful to try to come up with this visualization on your own first, because you really have to put in some effort to learning something and then you get the easy part on
cues.zh: 因為先自行視覺化有幫助，學習真的需要投入努力，之後在，

cues.en: the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張就能輕鬆看。

cues.en: Okay, So here you see this animation.
cues.zh: 好，動畫在這裡。

cues.en: So here's the unit circle.
cues.zh: 這是單位圓。

cues.en: This green circle is the unit circle and you see the radians going through as the angle of this line relative to this positive x axis.
cues.zh: 綠色是單位圓，弧度是這條線相對正 x 軸的角。

cues.en: So now it's up at two pi resets to zero.
cues.zh: 現在到 2π，重設成零。

cues.en: This is pi over two.
cues.zh: 這是 π/2。

cues.en: Here we have an angle of pi and so on.
cues.zh: 這裡是 π，依此類推。

cues.en: And now this is the plot of cosine.
cues.zh: 現在是餘弦圖。

cues.en: And what you can see is that the value of the cosine of this angle corresponds to the projection onto the x axis.
cues.zh: 能看到，這個角的餘弦值，對應投影到 x 軸的值。

cues.en: So here the projection is large, here is zero, here it's negative and the projection goes through zero and back up to being one again.
cues.zh: 這裡投影大，這裡零，這裡負，再通過零，回到一。

cues.en: And that's why this cosine function is waving up and down over time.
cues.zh: 所以餘弦隨時間上下波動。

cues.en: I often think of this as as time.
cues.zh: 我常把它想成時間。

cues.en: So and then here we have sine exactly the same concept as cosine, except here it's the projection onto
cues.zh: 這裡是正弦，概念相同，只是投影到，

cues.en: the y axis, which is also therefore sometimes called the sine axis.
cues.zh: y 軸，因此有時也叫正弦軸。

cues.en: So the projection onto the y axis as this angle moves around the unit circle corresponds to the sign of the angle as this vector is spinning around.
cues.zh: 向量繞單位圓旋轉時，投影到 y 軸的值，就是該角度的正弦。

cues.en: So here you see a plot of cosine and here is a plot of sine.
cues.zh: 這裡是餘弦，這裡正弦。

cues.en: So the way to read these graphs is that the value of theta or radians is on the x axis and the value
cues.zh: 圖的讀法是，θ 或弧度放 x 軸，數值，

cues.en: of the cosine of that radian value of that angle is on the y axis.
cues.zh: 也就是該弧度角的餘弦，放 y 軸。

cues.en: So this is for cosine and this is for sine.
cues.zh: 這是餘弦，這是正弦。

cues.en: So these plots are great because they reveal several interesting properties of these trig functions.
cues.zh: 這些圖很好，能顯示三角函數幾個有趣性質。

cues.en: And in particular I would like to point out three things.
cues.zh: 尤其想指出三點。

cues.en: First of all, the cosine at angle zero starts off at one and then it drops off symmetrically on both sides.
cues.zh: 第一，零角度的餘弦從一開始，再左右對稱下降。

cues.en: Secondly, the sine starts at zero.
cues.zh: 第二，正弦從零開始。

cues.en: At zero radians, the value of sine is zero, and then it goes up and to the right and down into the left.
cues.zh: 零弧度時正弦為零，再往右上升、往左下降。

cues.en: And there's actually specific terms for this characterization.
cues.zh: 描述這些特徵有特定名稱。

cues.en: Cosine is an even function and sine is an odd function.
cues.zh: 餘弦是偶函數，正弦是奇函數。

cues.en: I'm going to talk more about function symmetry in a few videos from now, but I've already mentioned this concept of symmetry and even an odd functions when I introduce polynomials.
cues.zh: 再幾支會談函數對稱；介紹多項式時，已提過對稱與奇偶函數。

cues.en: And so here you see that concept again.
cues.zh: 現在再次看到這概念。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then the third thing I would like to point out is that the value of the trig function for a certain
cues.zh: 第三，某個角度的三角函數值，

cues.en: angle is simply the y axis coordinate corresponding to that angle on the x axis.
cues.zh: 就是 x 軸該角度對應的 y 座標。

cues.en: So if you want to know the value of cosine for an angle of pi radians, you just look up pi over here
cues.zh: 所以要知道 π 弧度的餘弦，找到這裡 π，

cues.en: and then you see that the cosine of pi is minus one and the sign of pi is zero.
cues.zh: 就看到 cos(π)=−1，sin(π)=0。

cues.en: And then I want to give you one more graph of sine and cosine for a given theta angle and I hope that really hits home the point of how to interpret these two functions.
cues.zh: 再給一張特定 θ 下正弦、餘弦的圖，希望讓你徹底理解如何解讀。

cues.en: Okay, So we draw a line, a vector on a two axis where the two axes are the cosine and the sine, and
cues.zh: 畫一條線、向量，在兩軸上，分別是餘弦與正弦，

cues.en: then the values of the sign in cosine functions are the projections from the point that we define onto each of those axes.
cues.zh: 正弦、餘弦值就是所定義點，投影到各軸的值。

cues.en: So here's a simple example.
cues.zh: 簡單例子。

cues.en: We can define this point up here and then draw a vector that goes from sine from that point down to the cosine axis.
cues.zh: 定義上方這點，再從該點往下，畫向量到餘弦軸。

cues.en: And the projection, the value of that projection is our cosine for this particular angle.
cues.zh: 投影值就是這個角的餘弦。

cues.en: Now, in this case I've chosen a 90 degree or pi over two angle and there is no projection down onto the cosine axis.
cues.zh: 這裡選 90 度，或 π/2，沒有投影到餘弦軸的長度。

cues.en: So therefore the cosine of 90 degrees or pi over two is zero.
cues.zh: 所以 90 度、π/2 的餘弦為零。

cues.en: And that you also see here.
cues.zh: 這裡也看得到。

cues.en: So pi over two is going to be somewhere around here and cosine is zero.
cues.zh: π/2 大約在這裡，餘弦是零。

cues.en: And now we take the projection of this point onto the y axis or the sine axis and well in this case
cues.zh: 再把這點投影到 y 軸，也就是正弦軸，這裡，

cues.en: the projection onto the sine axis is exactly at that point already.
cues.zh: 剛好已經在那點。

cues.en: So the sign of this angle is the projection of this point onto the sine axis, which is basically as high as it gets, which is one and that you see here.
cues.zh: 所以正弦，就是投影到正弦軸的值，基本上已到最高的一，這裡看得到。

cues.en: So the sign of pi over two is one.
cues.zh: 因此 sin(π/2)=1。

cues.en: Now I'd like to get back to the tangent function.
cues.zh: 再回正切函數。

cues.en: Remember that tangent is a ratio of sine to cosine.
cues.zh: 還記得 tan 是 sin/cos。

cues.en: Now the sign and cosine functions are individually bound by minus one and plus one that you see here.
cues.zh: sin、cos 各自介於負一、正一，這裡看得到。

cues.en: But the ratio between sine and cosine is not bound.
cues.zh: 但兩者比值沒有界限。

cues.en: And in fact you can see that cosine actually approaches zero twice each cycle.
cues.zh: 其實 cos 每週期會兩次趨近零。

cues.en: And so that means that the tangent function will have these discontinuities where it blows up to plus infinity and it comes up from minus infinity.
cues.zh: 所以 tan 有這些不連續，衝向正無窮，再從負無窮出現。

cues.en: And you'll see more of this when you code the tangent function in Python.
cues.zh: 在 Python 寫 tan 時會看到更多。

cues.en: There are lots of interesting properties and so called identities involving trig functions.
cues.zh: 三角函數有很多有趣性質，也就是恆等式。

cues.en: Some of them are important and you need to learn and many of them are not that important, or at least not really that relevant.
cues.zh: 有些重要，需要學；很多則沒那麼重要，至少不太相關。

cues.en: And so you don't really need to commit them to memory.
cues.zh: 不必全背。

cues.en: Here is one interesting property and it's that cosine of two times an angle theta is equal to cosine squared theta minus sign squared theta.
cues.zh: 有個有趣性質，cos(2θ)=cos²(θ)−sin²(θ)。

cues.en: Now please help memorize this.
cues.zh: 請不用背這個。

cues.en: I'm just showing this as an example of the kinds of trig identities that exist, and I don't know how many trig identities there are in total.
cues.zh: 只是舉例，顯示有哪些三角恆等式；不知道總共有多少。

cues.en: It must be several dozen, but some.
cues.zh: 大概幾十個，但有些。

cues.en: Yeah, as I mentioned, some of them are relevant and some are not relevant.
cues.zh: 如前所說，有些相關，有些不相關。

cues.en: For now.
cues.zh: 目前。

cues.en: What I do want you to memorize is this identity.
cues.zh: 真正希望你記的是這個。

cues.en: So if you don't already have this identity burned into your brain, then please do it now.
cues.zh: 如果還沒深深刻在腦裡，現在請記住。

cues.en: Cosine squared of theta plus sine squared of the same theta.
cues.zh: cos²(θ)+sin²(θ)。

cues.en: These have to be the same angle and that equals one.
cues.zh: 必須是同一角度，等於一。

cues.en: Now what does this mean, What does this identity mean?
cues.zh: 這是什麼意思？這個恆等式？

cues.en: Well, let's go back to the unit circle and, and stick a right triangle in there and we can label some of these points and we can come up with the distance here.
cues.zh: 回到單位圓，放進直角三角形，標幾個點，就能算距離。

cues.en: Now, we already know that this distance is one because we are assuming that this is a unit circle.
cues.zh: 已經知道距離為一，因為假設是單位圓。

cues.en: So this hypotenuse here will have a distance of one, but we can formally calculate this distance here using the Euclidean distance formula, which I hope looks familiar.
cues.zh: 所以斜邊長為一，但可以正式用歐氏距離公式計算，希望你熟悉。

cues.en: Euclidean distance is the square root of squared distances.
cues.zh: 歐氏距離，是距離差平方和的平方根。

cues.en: So the distance or the difference between the corresponding x points and the corresponding Y points, you square those differences and some of them together and take the square root.
cues.zh: 對應 x、y 座標的差，分別平方、加起來，再開根號。

cues.en: And that gives you the distance between these two points.
cues.zh: 得到兩點距離。

cues.en: Okay, that's just a little reminder.
cues.zh: 好，只是簡單複習。

cues.en: So what I'm going to do now is work with this equation a little bit, recalling the identity that cosine
cues.zh: 現在稍微處理等式，回想餘弦，

cues.en: is equal to the ratio of the adjacent over the hypotenuse and sine is equal to the opposite over the hypotenuse.
cues.zh: 是鄰邊除斜邊，正弦是對邊除斜邊。

cues.en: And now I would already like you to notice that if we would square root, take the square root of both sides of this equation.
cues.zh: 也請注意，若對等式兩邊開平方根。

cues.en: Of course, the square root of one is still one.
cues.zh: 一的平方根當然仍是一。

cues.en: So we take the square root of both the sides of the equation.
cues.zh: 所以兩邊開平方根。

cues.en: Both sides of the equation, we get an expression that kind of looks like Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 就得到有點像歐氏距離的式子。

cues.en: We have the square root of the sum of squares.
cues.zh: 是平方和的平方根。

cues.en: Now, it's not actually what we need to do just yet.
cues.zh: 不過還不是現在需要做的。

cues.en: In fact, I'm just going to expand out these squared terms.
cues.zh: 其實先展開平方項。

cues.en: Now notice we have the sum of two fractions with the same denominator so we can combine them to get a squared plus.
cues.zh: 注意，同分母的兩個分數相加，可以合併成 a² 加。

cues.en: So the adjacent squared plus the opposite squared.
cues.zh: 就是鄰邊平方加對邊平方。

cues.en: And these are distances that we're working with here divided by the hypotenuse squared equals one.
cues.zh: 這裡是距離，再除斜邊平方，等於一。

cues.en: Now we already know that the hypotenuse squared is equal to one, because we started from the assumption that this is a unit circle.
cues.zh: 知道斜邊平方為一，因為從單位圓假設出發。

cues.en: So this form here should look familiar.
cues.zh: 這形式應該熟悉。

cues.en: This is the form for the Pythagorean theorem.
cues.zh: 是畢氏定理。

cues.en: This distance squared plus this.
cues.zh: 這個距離平方，加這個。

cues.en: This distance squared equals the hypotenuse squared.
cues.zh: 距離平方，等於斜邊平方。

cues.en: And we know that this is one, as I've already mentioned.
cues.zh: 知道它是一，如前所述。

cues.en: So essentially, by working with this equation a little bit, we have demonstrated this identity that cosine squared plus sine squared equals one.
cues.zh: 所以稍微處理等式，就示範 cos²+sin²=1。

cues.zh: 好，這支介紹三角學最重要的正弦與餘弦。

cues.en: I explained that these are simply ratios of two sides of a right triangle and they can spin around in
cues.zh: 解釋它們只是直角三角形兩邊之比，三角形能繞著，

cues.en: a unit circle to create those wavy looking, cosine and sine plots that you're used to looking at.
